tagline: Fast, fluid storage visualizer & squarified treemap for Android
brief: Deep filesystem scanner and squarified treemap visualizer with Apple-inspired fluid motion, dark OLED glassmorphism, and instant disk breakdown.

concepts.name: The Treemap D
concepts.idea: A squarified treemap monogram forming a bold, modern letter D.
rationale: Synthesizes 'Droid' with the recursive treemap subdivision algorithm.
Monolithic vertical spine anchors three proportional nested data blocks.
Flawless legibility from 16px menu bar icon to large display squircle.

concepts.name: The Storage Iris
concepts.idea: Concentric radial scanner: DaisyDisk sectors with an active aperture.
rationale: Visualizes storage depth as concentric orbital layers revolving around a central disk core.
The intentional open aperture evokes a high-speed radar sweep and scanner beam.
Communicates instant visibility and fluid circular gauge instrumentation.

concepts.name: The Synthetic Arbor
concepts.idea: Hierarchical directory tree branching into precision storage data nodes.
rationale: Translates filesystem tree traversal into a minimalist computational bonsai.
Geometric 45-degree bifurcations terminate in proportional circular memory nodes.
Negative space subtly echoes the iconic dome curve of Android architecture.

recommendation: The Storage Iris (Concept C) delivers the purest Apple-grade instrument feel, pairing seamlessly with DroidTree's circular storage gauges and dark fluid theme.
